name: Evacuation decision triggers
description: Define the conditions that cause the household or group to leave instead of sheltering in place.
notes: Examples: official order, visible fire/flood, unsafe home, prolonged outage.

name: Primary evacuation route
description: Document the first-choice route, including key roads, choke points, and known hazards.
notes: Include offline map references and route notes.

name: Secondary evacuation route
description: Document a backup route if the primary road, bridge, or exit is blocked.
notes: Use MECP road blocked or bridge out events if conditions change.

name: Destination
description: Define where the household will go, such as a relative, hotel, shelter, or out-of-area contact.
notes: Include address, contact name, fallback destination, and arrival check-in instructions.

name: Primary rally point
description: Choose the first meeting point if household members are separated.
notes: Make it easy to reach without internet.

name: Backup rally point
description: Choose a second meeting point if the primary rally point is unsafe or unreachable.
notes: Use a location in a different direction from the primary point if possible.

name: Out-of-area contact
description: Identify a person outside the affected area who can relay status if local communications fail.
notes: Include phone, address, call sign, and non-mesh contact method.

name: Go-bag staging
description: Define where grab bags are stored and who is responsible for taking them.
notes: Include individual bags, pet bag, medical bag, documents, and charging kit.

name: Document grab list
description: List the critical documents to take during evacuation.
notes: IDs, insurance, prescriptions, contacts, property records, cash, and printed plan.

name: Medication and medical devices
description: Plan how medications, mobility aids, and powered medical devices leave with the household.
notes: Include chargers, spare batteries, prescriptions, and backup caregiver instructions.

name: Pet evacuation supplies
description: Define carriers, leashes, food, water, vaccination records, and pet-friendly destination needs.

name: Vehicle fuel and charging
description: Set minimum fuel, EV charge, bike readiness, or alternate transport requirements before departure.
notes: Add trigger such as keep vehicle above half tank during warning periods.

name: Neighbor notification
description: Decide which neighbors or trusted contacts should be notified when leaving.
notes: Use low-detail updates if privacy is a concern.

name: Departure check-in
description: Send a short movement update before leaving, including destination and route only to approved recipients.
notes: Example: evacuating, en route, ETA, destination alias.

name: Arrival confirmation
description: Confirm arrival and update safety, medical, mobility, power, and communications status.
notes: Include any unmet needs after arrival.
